name: mathtuber
title_zh: 本地 Manim 出片，旁白剪辑一条龙
tagline_zh: 数学讲解、视觉证明、教育 Shorts——从脚本到成片都在本机跑，不传云端。改稿、复盘、续做旧项目，一个命令接着干。
tagline_en: Math explainers, visual proofs, Shorts—script to final cut stays on your machine. Revise, resume old projects.
desc_en: Create, revise, review, resume, and optionally publish narrated mathematical animation videos with local Manim and speech tools. Use for math explainers, visual proofs, educational Shorts, and existing MathTuber projects.
why_zh: 把「写代码→渲染→配音→剪辑→发布」串成一条可续跑流水线，每次改动只重渲染受影响片段，不推倒重来。
why_en: Chains code→render→voice→edit→publish into one resumable pipeline; edits re-render only affected clips, not the whole video.
limit_zh: 本机需装好 Manim、ffmpeg 及至少一个 TTS 引擎；只认数学动画视频这一品类，不做真人出镜或幻灯片式讲解。
limit_en: Requires local Manim, ffmpeg, and one TTS engine. Only for narrated math animation videos—not vlogs or slide-style talks.
title_en: Local Manim math videos with narration, cut & publish
